ONE MONTH OF ASSET BOUND. 🖤  One month ago, Asset Bound left our hands and found its way into yours.  Since then, we’ve watched it travel from bookshelves to bedside tables, cafés, bags, and reading corners. Captured, shared, annotated, and, most importantly, read.  So here’s to one month of Asset Bound in the wild. And to everyone who made it part of theirs.  We’re only getting started. 🦋

Every city has stories hiding in ordinary places.  Bring us yours. 📍  Stories on the Move Workshop 26 September 2026. 2 PM Advanced Pathways Global, Sidi Yahia.  Atlas House x Advanced Pathways Global Your city has stories. What’s yours?

📍 Got a place that means something to you?  A street. A café. A building. A random corner with a story only you know.  Let’s turn those places into stories. 👀  Stories on the Move is a free, in-person workshop where we’ll share memories, discover what connects our stories, and build a digital heritage trail together. 🗺️✨  📅 September 26th. 🕑 2 PM 📍 Advanced Pathways Global — Sidi Yahia, Algiers 🎟️ Free & in person  🔗 Register through the link in our bio!

Last Saturday was one of those days that just feels good. 🤍  We gathered in a room full of lovely people, grabbed some markers, and started talking about the places we love: the café we always go back to, the street that feels like home, the corner that holds a memory only you know.  Somewhere between the drawings, the stories and a lot of laughter, we built a little trail of our city together. 🗺️  Thank you to everyone who came, shared a piece of their story and made the room feel so warm. You're the heart of Stories on the Move. ✨  And a big thank you to @advancedpathwaysglobal for hosting us so beautifully. We felt right at home. 🙏  Which place in your city would you add to the trail? We'd love to hear 👇
